checks.name: Practice presents connected vocabulary, verbs and grammar; vocabulary opens directly in typing mode
Wrong and hinted answers remain honest; drafts/hints survive reload and pause; completion offers a clear stopping point
Vocabulary and Games retain independent unfinished rounds and typed answers
The expanded library is searchable and paged; new topics open matching cards and saved words appear in the shared word bank
Saving a grammar-only expression leads to a typed round accepting one valid form, with the extra word catalogue collapsed
The shared review queue opens the scheduled typed word and retains its original first attempt
Keyboard-only answering and continuation work, with focused feedback and a visible focus outline
Accent keys insert correctly; Show the answer records support without independent credit; completion receives focus
Initial and repeated local PIN mismatches focus a visible alert in a short viewport without contacting the profile service
EN/IT routes, questions, feedback and completion fit portrait, desktop and short landscape without overflow, clipping or undersized controls
200% CSS zoom and a reduced-height keyboard approximation remain scrollable and operable; no physical keyboard claim
No uncaught browser errors or profile-service requests in the synthetic guest journeys

390px expanded word card, example, noun forms and recall record
fixesDuringAudit: Gave topic/level/source selects concise accessible labels.
Connected private-PDF action to the existing materials route.
Started library-selected rounds in the typing view.
Retained all-word review selection on reload.
Allowed paused-round browsing with explicit resume and disabled competing starts.
Removed conflicting paper texture from flat navigation and saved-word controls.
limits: Automated Chromium journeys; no human usability study or physical-device claim.
Local private PDF connections expire on reload by design.
This local audit did not exercise live profile sync; the later publication and public browser checks are recorded separately.
Build retains existing large content-chunk warnings.
